package service

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

// S9 intentionally has no legacy AssignCourse/CreateLearningPath methods.
type OnboardingPathExecutionStudentService interface {
	ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, string, string) (OnboardingPathAdmission, error)
	RenewOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, string, int64, string, string) (OnboardingPathAdmission, error)
	MaterializeOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, OnboardingPathMaterialization) (OnboardingPathMaterialization, error)
	AbortOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, string, int64, string, string, string) error
}

type OnboardingPathAdmission struct {
	AdmissionID string
	Fence       int64
	Replayed    bool
	ExpiresAt   time.Time
}
type OnboardingPathMaterialization struct {
	StudentID            string
	AdmissionID          string
	ExecutionID          string
	Fence                int64
	CourseID             string
	CourseFingerprint    string
	PlannerPolicyVersion string
	ReasonCode           string
	ReasonSummary        string
	Lessons              []domain.CourseLessonBinding
	Status               string
	LearningPathID       string
	FirstLessonID        string
	Replayed             bool
	IdempotencyKey       string
}
